title: The King's Mercy
logline: A brother buys a royal pardon, then risks his own freedom to discover where the pardoned prisoners go.
central_conflict: A brother buys a royal pardon, then risks his own freedom to discover where the pardoned prisoners go.
theme: A well-meant attempt to help carries a cost that forces a more difficult choice.

characters.name: Ivo
characters.personality: Resourceful, emotionally invested, prepared to risk a clear cost.
characters.desire: Find his sister and bring her home alive.
characters.flaw: He trusts a signed document more than the people it supposedly protects.
characters.voice_direction: Natural and specific; composed intent turns to alarm through the consequences.

characters.name: Sera
characters.personality: A distinct counterpart with a practical objective, not a generic warning voice.
characters.desire: Keep her post and avoid punishment while deciding whether to help Ivo.
characters.flaw: Trusts procedure or immediate appearances before testing the implication.
characters.voice_direction: Clearly different timbre; measured, then personally unsettled by evidence.

environments.description: A royal prison record office with a directly adjoining empty cell visible through an archway. The transfer book, seal, knife and corridor watch bell remain in consistent geography.

pardon_owned.statement: Ivo has obtained a royal pardon for his imprisoned sister.

central.question: Can Ivo reach the departing ship, and who turned pardons into a trafficking route?
central.writer_only_answer: A royal minister has been commuting executions into coerced labor sales; Sera has recorded transfers without knowing their destination.

season_arc.goal: Find his sister and bring her home alive.
season_arc.conflict: A brother buys a royal pardon, then risks his own freedom to discover where the pardoned prisoners go.
season_arc.turn: The transfer book names a sale and a ship leaving tonight.
season_arc.payoff: The first method fails and exposes the larger problem.

season_arc.goal: Reach the prison ship before it leaves the harbor.
season_arc.conflict: Ivo is now wanted for breaking the royal seal; Sera can forge his passage only by signing her own name to the false manifest.
season_arc.turn: His sister has refused a chance to escape because another prisoner cannot walk.
season_arc.payoff: Sera chooses to betray her office; Ivo boards with a new obligation to rescue more than his sister.

season_arc.goal: Free the prisoners and preserve proof of the pardon sales.
season_arc.conflict: The broker offers to release Ivo sister in exchange for the transfer book; surrendering it would leave the other prisoners to be sold.
season_arc.turn: A royal minister has been converting pardons into forced-labor sales and using cancelled execution notices to hide the missing people.
season_arc.payoff: Ivo and his sister choose a dangerous collective escape; Sera publicizes the duplicate ledger instead of accepting a private bargain.
